manifest.display_name: The Fatty Liver Diet Cookbook for Type 2 Diabetes
manifest.objective: One way of eating for both conditions: 30 days of Mediterranean-style meals from everyday supermarket ingredients, energy-controlled for steady weight loss, very low in added sugar, fiber- and protein-forward, and alcohol-free — built to help lower liver fat and keep blood sugar steady.
